The test image shows a tomato stem cut open longitudinally, revealing:
- Brown/tan rotted interior tissue
- A hollow, decayed pith cavity
- Dark irregular bodies (sclerotia) visible inside the stem
- Tan/brown external stem lesion

The presence of sclerotia inside a hollowed, rotted stem is the hallmark of Sclerotinia Timber Rot. Let me confirm with a reference image.

The reference image shows Sclerotinia Timber Rot with tan/brown stem collapse on tomato plants with black plastic mulch (matching the background in the test image). The test image's cross-section reveals the classic internal sclerotia (dark hard bodies) inside a hollowed, rotted pith — the defining diagnostic feature of *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*. This matches Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot perfectly.
